verdict.rationale: Whether customer data may be used to train AI models is a fair question for an AI observability SaaS that stores traces, prompts and datasets, so this axis applies. The pack contains no no-training policy, training opt-out setting, or contractual commitment about model training. The self-hosting option keeps data in the customer's own cloud for residency and compliance, but that is an adjacent control and says nothing about training use, so it earns no credit.
